correctness.rationale: Seven exact local formulas reduce all words to 81 signatures; the finite certificate lists all states, 59 fingerprints, and 46 persistent classes. A complete stars-and-bars formula counts every fiber; 45 explicitly certified polynomial competitors have strictly positive forward-difference gaps (minima 10,23,8,1) from N=15 onward. Complete independent substring checks on 2401 small-gap words and all weight-three words through length 28 corroborate, but the finite exhaustive-state argument and Newton formula prove the infinite claims.

value.rationale: The exact constant 46 is the optimal code size for a standard fixed-weight trigram-multispectrum observation at every n>=11, and one uniquely maximal fiber has asymptotic density 1 for all n>=18. This sharp structural collapse quantifies intrinsic information loss, independently useful in finite-length read reconstruction and code design. The classification is complete and not simply a table lookup or arbitrary exceptional slice.
